digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow routing and documentation gates
propositions: Documentation-only changes currently consume the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, and all supporting jobs instead of running a reduced verification lane.
A trusted classifier must execute from origin/main to safely route patchsets to either docs-only verification or full verification without importing untrusted patchset logic.

Shared documentation gates (ADR validation, index checks, drift detection, DCO identity) must be extracted into a single composite action and invoked by both full and docs-only routes to avoid duplication and preserve all guards.
Structural test consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, and seven others) must be migrated to follow the extracted action without losing assertions.

Documentation-only route requires classifier success and route=docs-only output; classifier failure must still run full-route jobs and block Verified even when those jobs pass, preserving fail-closed semantics.
An empty, malformed, unreadable, parentless diff, any Python/shell/executable/workflow/dependency/configuration path, or any unknown path must select full Verify, not docs-only.
